rootCause.observed: The calibrated viewer showed Opacity ON but the feather backing remained visible.
rootCause.primary: Sketchfab masking is a dedicated AlphaMask material channel; Opacity is not the correct cutout channel for feather-card voids.
rootCause.secondary: Earlier diagnostic textures could encode coverage only in PNG alpha while leaving RGB white, which is unsafe when a channel samples grayscale RGB.

requiredChannelOrder: reuse and enable an existing material.channels.AlphaMask texture when present
otherwise derive a UV-aligned grayscale mask from the selected material source atlas
register the derived image with addTexture
write the texture UID to material.channels.AlphaMask.texture
leave the Opacity channel unchanged unless a separate blending test is explicitly required
